title: feat(website): advertise agent entry points with RFC 8288 Link headers
author: kreggscode

gist.summary: Added an RFC 8288 Link header to HTML responses for /, /play, /apps, /community, /terms, /privacy, /subprocessors, and /refunds. It points agents to six existing gen.pollinations.ai resources: /llms.txt, the RFC 9727 API catalog, the SEP-2127 AI catalog, the Agent Skills index, /openapi.json, and /docs/llm.txt. Agents can discover the API surface from a website page without scraping HTML or guessing URLs; unknown routes and non-HTML assets are unchanged. The links are set on the SEO Worker response, with no new endpoints or duplicated content.
